rationale: B is better structured and more robust: it validates the basic puzzle shape, rejects puzzles with more than ten distinct letters early, tolerates reasonable whitespace variation, and uses indexed assignments plus per-column multiplicities. Most importantly, it derives an unassigned result digit directly from the column sum, whereas A needlessly tries every available digit for the result letter, substantially expanding the search. B is somewhat over-permissive when parsing separators and both implementations implicitly assume ASCII words, but B remains clearer and more efficient overall.
